notes: RBox revision on lobe_of (subproperty of part_of): 'is a lobe of' stops being a subproperty of 'is part of', so 'X is a lobe of Y' no longer licenses 'X is part of Y'. The instances are real lobes (the caudate lobe of the liver, the flocculonodular lobe of the cerebellum); the conclusion sentences have no exact Dolma hits. The direct question spells out what the subproperty means. Unrelated near: 'is a chamber of' is still a subproperty of 'is part of' (a leak turns yes into no); unrelated far asks a different property of an unrelated relation. hops counts the prompt facts as one bridge. Propositional negation is worded 'Is it true that ... not ...?'. Paired with the contraction and the expansion of the same property. Known weakness: a lobe of an organ is part of it by the meaning of the word, so a model can keep answering yes from the stored meaning rather than from a failed edit.
